title: CRUVIT climate coverage object-storage contract
architecture: CRUVIT CENTRAL BAKE → COMPRESSED CLIMATE TILES → CRUVIT-CONTROLLED OBJECT STORAGE → manifest/index → runtime exact coordinate lookup
preferredBackendStatus: PREFERRED — production wiring/upload not yet complete

runtimeRules.runtimePattern: simple object GET + manifest/index — no R2 SQL / Data Catalog / Workers unless later Owner-required

r2CostModelNotFree.note: R2 is NOT free. Include storage $/GB-month, Class A ops, Class B ops, and any future optional R2 services actually used. Zero internet egress is an advantage, not a $0 total claim.

forbids: full global climate-cell inventory as Postgres rows
coupling large climate-byte delivery to Supabase Storage egress

supabaseStorage.egressNotes: Included quotas vary by plan; overage can dominate
supabaseStorage.requestCosts: API requests billed on some plans
supabaseStorage.fit: Fine for small regional packs; review egress before global

cloudflareR2.egressNotes: Zero egress to Internet under current R2 pricing (major advantage for tile downloads)
cloudflareR2.requestCosts: Class A/B operations priced — must be in cost model

recommendation.why: S3-compatible CRUVIT-controlled store; zero internet egress under current R2 pricing; immutable versioned tiles; avoids Supabase egress coupling. Keep Garden profiles in Supabase DB; keep climate tiles in R2. R2 is preferred, not claimed free.
